This cute two room apartment is located in the popular Rotterdam North area, close to the city centre. The apartment is in an older but functional condition and offers plenty of space for comfortable living.

The property consists of two rooms and is suitable for either a couple or two people sharing the apartment. It is rented unfurnished, allowing you to furnish and decorate the space according to your own preferences. The current tenants do want to sell on some of their furniture, ask the real estate agent for the possibilities.

The apartment is conveniently located near supermarkets, restaurants, cafés and public transport connections, providing easy access to Rotterdam Central Station and the rest of the city.

A practical and spacious home in a lively and well connected part of Rotterdam.

Hey everyone, I’m looking for a new tenant for a furnished room in Rotterdam, available for a November move-in. 

It’s a 15m2 space located about a 5-minute walk from the main train station, which has been incredibly convenient for commuting and getting around the city. 6-min from a grocery center. 10-min to the lake.

A few quick details:
- The room comes fully furnished
- Official registration with the municipality is absolutely possible
- Move-in date: November

It’s a solid, straightforward setup in a great location, ideal for a student or professional looking to be centrally located. 

Since you'll be sharing the apartment, we want to make sure it's a great fit for everyone. If you're interested, please send over a message with a short description of yourself so we can get to know you as a future roommate. 

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Spacious unfurnished apartment of approximately 68 m2 available at Mathenesserweg 131B in Rotterdam West.

The apartment has two spacious rooms and a flexible layout. It can be used traditionally as a living room and one bedroom, or by two people sharing the apartment, with both rooms used as separate bedrooms.

The property is offered unfurnished. However, the current tenants are willing to sell several pieces of furniture to the new tenants if interested.

The apartment is conveniently located close to supermarkets, shops and public transport, with Rotterdam city centre easily accessible by bicycle or public transport.

The apartment is suitable for a maximum of two tenants.

Rent: €1,400 per month, excluding utilities.
